snippet.title: CLUE/CLUEDO | Coming Soon | Official Video Game Trailer
snippet.description:
The official Clue/Cluedo board game is coming to mobile and Steam, delivering a fresh take on the iconic crime-solving classic. Join fellow detectives all over the world to gather crucial evidence, interrogate suspects, and solve the original murder mystery. 

Follow your suspects to stunning international locations to understand their motives and alibis. Crack each case the way you've done before or try a new investigation format. Solve the murder your way and become the detective you want to be!

Find out more: https://www.marmaladegamestudio.com/games/cluedo-2023/

Pre-Order:

App Store - ''Clue'' https://bit.ly/46bNLGL | ''Cluedo'' https://bit.ly/448zskO 
Google Play - https://bit.ly/3P7XcB3

Wishlist it on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2506480/ClueCluedo/
